provenance.dataset: Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates
provenance.cadence: Each business day, published around 3:30 pm ET.
provenance.reliability: Primary source. This IS the official curve, not a vendor copy.
provenance.caveat: Par yields derived from the on-the-run bid side at roughly 3:30 pm ET. Not intraday. A big afternoon move lands in tomorrow’s print.
provenance.quality_meaning: Fetched from the originating source. This is a real observation.

move.detail: +6 bp. Bigger in magnitude than 91% of the 2696 moves since 2016-01-05. The typical move is 2.2 bp; this is 1.2 sigma.

insights.stat_line: Sitting in the top of its 1-year range, at the 99th percentile.

impact.meaning: A RISE in this series pushes mortgage rates UP. A fall pushes them DOWN.
impact.no_chain_note: This series is not a node in the causal graph. It is context, not a modeled driver of mortgage rates.
